messages:
Alex: CI on main is red after the merge of PR #4328 — failing integration tests in the cache suite. Anyone oncall to help bisect?
Priya: Yup saw it, buildkite link: https://ci.example.com/builds/9342 — failing test is KVCacheEvictionTest::EvictWhileServing, looks flaky (timeout + assert). Logs: `Assertion failed: entries.size() == 0` around eviction path.
Sasha: I skimmed the diff in #4328 — it changes compaction scheduling/timers. could definitely affect eviction timing.
ci-bot: Last green on main: commit sha abcdef1 (2026-02-14 03:21 UTC). Builds since then: 5, 2 red, 3 flakes.
Priya: Can someone run a quick bisect? If it's the scheduling change we should either revert or hotfix quickly.
Kevin: I can start a bisect on a worker. Plan: git bisect start main abcdef1 && git bisect run ./ci/scripts/run-integration.sh -- tests/kv_cache_eviction
Alex: Thanks @Kevin — can you run it against our dockerized CI image (same env as buildkite)? Add --use-container. Also capture a few reproductions per commit (rerun flaky tests).
Kevin: Yep doing that now. Command I'm running: `GITHUB_TOKEN=$TOKEN /ci/tools/bisect --image=redwood/ci:202602 --retries=3 --parallel=4 --script=./ci/scripts/run-integration.sh -- tests/kv_cache_eviction`
Priya: If bisect points to a recent merge, we should prepare a revert PR and a canary rollback on dedicated to reduce customer impact.
Sasha: Also flagging owners of compaction module @storage-team — they should be on standby for a quick patch.
Kevin: First update: bisect started, queued ~8 builds, ETA ~12m. I'll post the culprit commit if found. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Kevin: Update: bisect narrowed it down to commit 64a1f3b (merge of PR #4328) — reproduces 5/5 locally with retries. Suspect: change to compaction delay (sleep removed).
Alex: OK, let's revert PR #4328 on main and cut a hotfix branch. Priya can you open the revert and coordinate the merge?
Priya: On it — opening revert PR now, will link the rollback run and schedule a canary job.
Sasha: Once revert merges, let's run a full stage integration smoke to validate.
Alex: Great work all, please post final statuses here and close the thread when main is green. :thumbsup:
